biology:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: ONE production transparent biology sprite atlas for the EduSphere game. Reference image role: exact art style and subject silhouettes from the supplied approved mockups, not a request for another interface. Recreate their polished illustrated artwork faithfully: saturated friendly colors, rich rounded forms, nuanced tonal depth and soft highlights, confident deep indigo outlines where shown, crisp high quality game illustration. NOT tiny simplified SVG-like symbols.
Create a precisely aligned 4-column by 3-row grid, twelve equal rectangular cells, on a fully transparent canvas. Each object centered in its cell, occupying 78% of its cell with safe transparent margins, no overlap. No labels, no letters, no borders, no UI, no drop shadows outside objects. Row1 left-to-right: warm yellow sun with rays; carbon dioxide molecule with gray central sphere and two coral red spheres; luminous blue water droplet; rich green oval chloroplast with detailed stacks of bright green thylakoid discs. Row2: two white glucose cubes plus two joined blue oxygen spheres as one group; orange mitochondrion with detailed coral inner folded membrane; large lavender animal cell with purple nucleus, curved purple membranes, small green and teal organelles and orange mitochondria, matching desktop reference; golden upright energy battery with a dark amber lightning bolt and NO lettering. Row3: pink stomach; purple fermentation flask with bubbles; vivid green two-leaf seedling; teal and lilac cluster of cofactor spheres. All twelve share reference quality and lighting. This is an atlas for CSS background positioning: exact equal grid cell alignment is crucial. Landscape 4:3 canvas at high resolution.
